items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is where Papa Stamson did with me. When he got family, he forgot I was living.

ctx.x: Yeah. You see, why hire Buddy Petit? Nobody didn't want to hire him no more. I mean, in other words, he couldn't get no job. I heard he wasn't very reliable sometimes. That's when he came to Aquaman during the A-Mone, one day they lined my chance. I told him, I said, I got a first trumpet player. I said, if you want to play second, I mean, well, he said, that would be alright when he came in and worked with me a long time playing second trumpet.
This is where Papa Stamson did with me. When he got family, he forgot I was living.
That's the way it is. That's the way it is. That's right. That's right. That's the way them fellas is. I worked with Celestine a while too. I mean, I worked with him a while.
